scope: Read actual code, four written reports, summary and CSV results. No rerun of main matrix audit, no Monte Carlo, no new algorithm, and no edits to audited code.
limitations: Pairwise C/P names refer to fixed reference-event windows, not each candidate's individual lifecycle phases.
No detection power, localization accuracy, MSE or global false alarm performance was tested.
Full-rank known-event observation does not by itself exclude improved noisy unknown-event discrimination.
Known-event unconditional GLS estimation-error covariance remains valid when K O = I, even if Replay amplitude and healthy noise are correlated; it is not a selected-event conditional posterior.
The scoped gate failure is not a theorem excluding every Yang network, window or same-information feature representation.
publication_check: Ensure referenced NPZ assets are explicitly included in the final Git whitelist if global ignore rules exclude them.
